full_name: Lixing Sun | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Biological Sciences Hrdy Fellow Central Washington University
bio: A researcher, educator, and science writer, Lixing Sun has devoted his life to pursuing a wide range of issues in behavioral and evolutionary biology, spanning the study of sex, sexual selection, animal communication, and cooperation by integrating approaches in biology, psychology, anthropology, and behavioral economics.
